tex_content.html:
Corollary
[smoothness of $r$ up to the cut point]

Source: petersen:page-0236 ↗ def:pet-ch5-cut-locus ↗ lem:pet-ch5-cut-locus-characterization 1. ch5:5.7.11Let $c:[0,\infty )\to M$ be a geodesic, $c(0)=p$, and $\operatorname {cut}(\dot c(0))=\sup \{ t\mid c|_{[0,t]}\text{ is a segment}\} $. Then $r$ is smooth at $c(t)$ for $t<\operatorname {cut}(\dot c(0))$ but not at $x=c(\operatorname {cut}(\dot c(0)))$, the failure being either that $\exp _p$ is not one-to-one at $x$ or that $x$ is a critical value of $\exp _p$.
Proof

↗ cor:pet-ch5-cut-locus-smoothness \sketch Before the cut time, $tv\in \operatorname {seg}^0(p)$; at the cut time it lies on the star boundary. The smoothness assertion follows from subsection 7.3, and the two possible failures are exactly those in subsection 7.3.

□
